newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Hasina says Bangladesh to be part of Asian Highway.
newsitem.headline: Hasina says Bangladesh to be part of Asian Highway.

text.p: Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina said her government is taking initiatives to link the country with the proposed Asian Highway and Asian Railway, the Daily Star newspaper said on Saturday.
"We can't afford to remain disconnected with other countries in this modern world," the paper quoted Hasina as telling a meeting of her Awami League party on Friday.
Hasina said India was trying to divert the planned highway through its northeastern states of Assam and Tripura, keeping away from Bangladesh.
"But we can't allow our country to be disconnected... depriving her of connections through the Asian Highway and Asian Railway. It is required for the economic interest of our country," Hasina said.

Hasina did not explain the planned highway or railway network or what moves were planned by Bangladesh. Railway officials in Dhaka said the objective of the proposed Trans Asian Railway was to connect Southeast Asia with Turkey through South Asia and the Middle-East.
